name: LeanTouchPlus.asmdef
summary: Unity assembly definition that compiles every script in this package into the LeanTouchPlus assembly, referencing the external LeanCommon, LeanTouch, LeanCommonPlus and CW.Common assemblies.

name: Documentation.html
summary: Official Lean Touch+ manual (v3.1.1): explains that the package extends Lean Touch and catalogs every bundled demo scene together with the component and settings each scene demonstrates.

name: IDropHandler.cs
summary: Declares the single-method IDropHandler interface that marks a component as a valid drop target for LeanSelectableDrop.

name: LeanDragColorMesh.cs
summary: Component that paints the vertex colors of the attached MeshFilter's mesh wherever fingers drag across it, plus its inspector editor.

name: LeanDragDeformMesh.cs
summary: Component that deforms a mesh by dragging its vertices with fingers, optionally pushing the result back into the MeshCollider, plus its inspector editor.

name: LeanDragLine.cs
summary: Specialisation of the external LeanDragTrail that renders each finger's drag as a straight line and fires from/to/delta events when the finger is released.

name: LeanDragSelect.cs
summary: Component that lets a single finger drag across the screen to select every selectable it passes through, plus its inspector editor.

name: LeanDragTranslateAlong.cs
summary: Base component that drags a Transform along a target surface or path by snapping the finger's screen position onto it, plus its inspector editor.

name: LeanDragTranslateAlongRigidbody.cs
summary: Rigidbody flavour of LeanDragTranslateAlong that applies the snapped movement in FixedUpdate via physics instead of writing the Transform directly.

name: LeanDragTranslateRigidbody.cs
summary: Component that drags a 3D Rigidbody with the fingers, moving it in FixedUpdate toward the finger's screen point with optional damping.

name: LeanDragTranslateRigidbody2D.cs
summary: 2D counterpart of LeanDragTranslateRigidbody: drags a Rigidbody2D with the fingers through the physics step.

name: LeanDrop.cs
summary: Drop target component: implements IDropHandler and raises an OnDropped UnityEvent with the dropped GameObject.

name: LeanDropCount.cs
summary: Drop target that counts how many objects have been dropped on it and raises match/unmatch events when the count enters or leaves a configured range.

name: LeanFingerDownCanvas.cs
summary: UI variant of the external LeanFingerDown component that only reacts to fingers pressing the Canvas element it is attached to.

name: LeanFingerFlick.cs
summary: Swipe detector that fires while the finger is still touching the screen, rather than waiting for release, plus its inspector editor.

name: LeanFingerHeld.cs
summary: Core hold-detection component: fires down/update/up events once a finger has stayed on the screen for MinimumAge without moving more than MaximumMovement. Base class for the Canvas variant.

name: LeanFingerHeldCanvas.cs
summary: UI variant of LeanFingerHeld that only detects holds on the Canvas element it is attached to.

name: LeanFingerTapExpired.cs
summary: Tap component that only fires once the tap counter has expired, which is how single and double taps are told apart without interfering.

name: LeanFingerTapQuick.cs
summary: Detects the final tap of a multi-tap sequence at the moment the finger touches down, giving instant response for the last tap only.

name: LeanFirstDown.cs
summary: Fires events only when the first finger begins touching the screen, ignoring additional simultaneous fingers. Base class for the Canvas variant.

name: LeanFirstDownCanvas.cs
summary: UI variant of LeanFirstDown that only counts fingers pressing the Canvas element it is attached to.

name: LeanGestureToggle.cs
summary: Arbitrates between drag, pinch and twist components by enabling only the one whose gesture exceeded its threshold first, the way mobile map apps isolate gestures.

name: LeanLastUp.cs
summary: Fires events when the last finger stops touching the screen, the release-side counterpart to LeanFirstDown. Base class for the Canvas variant.

name: LeanLastUpCanvas.cs
summary: UI variant of LeanLastUp that only tracks fingers which started on the Canvas element it is attached to.

name: LeanManualFlick.cs
summary: Swipe detector whose fingers are fed in manually via AddFinger by components such as LeanFingerDown or LeanFingerDownCanvas, so a flick can be scoped to a specific object or UI element.

name: LeanManualSwipe.cs
summary: Swipe-detection component that only reacts to fingers explicitly handed to it, so a swipe can be scoped to fingers registered by another component such as LeanFingerDown or LeanFingerDownCanvas.

name: LeanMouseWheel.cs
summary: Turns mouse wheel scrolling into a float UnityEvent so wheel input can drive other components (zoom, scale, dial) without custom code.

name: LeanMultiDirection.cs
summary: Measures how far one or more filtered fingers have moved along a configured screen direction and emits that distance as a float event.

name: LeanMultiDown.cs
summary: Fires UnityEvents the moment a specific number of fingers are simultaneously pressing the screen, reporting the finger list plus the screen and world center.

name: LeanMultiHeld.cs
summary: Detects a sustained multi-finger hold: once the required fingers have stayed down past a minimum age (within a movement tolerance) it fires down/update/up event triples for finger list, screen center, and world position.

name: LeanMultiPinch.cs
summary: Reports the pinch (scale) ratio of all filtered fingers as a float event, letting designers wire pinch straight into scale or zoom.

name: LeanMultiPull.cs
summary: Continuously reports where the filtered fingers are relative to where they first went down, which is what an invisible on-screen joystick needs.

name: LeanMultiSwipe.cs
summary: Detects a simultaneous multi-finger swipe, distinguishing a parallel swipe from a pinch-in or pinch-out swipe, and fires when the first finger leaves the screen.

name: LeanMultiTap.cs
summary: Counts multi-taps - one or more fingers pressed and released together within the tap threshold - and reports the tap count and the highest simultaneous finger count.

name: LeanMultiTwist.cs
summary: Reports the twist (rotation) angle of all filtered fingers as a float event, with a configurable fallback for how a single finger is interpreted.

name: LeanMultiUp.cs
summary: Fires UnityEvents when a specific number of fingers stop touching the screen, reporting the releasing finger plus the screen and world position.

name: LeanMultiUpdate.cs
summary: The general-purpose workhorse of the LeanMulti family: reports the per-frame change in position of all filtered fingers as delta, distance, and world from/to events, with optional axis constraining.

name: LeanMultiUpdateCanvas.cs
summary: Canvas variant of LeanMultiUpdate that only counts fingers currently overlapping this UI element, so drag-style events fire for the RectTransform rather than the whole screen.

name: LeanPick.cs
summary: Scene-level picker that raycasts a screen position for a LeanPickable and notifies it, providing a lightweight alternative to the full LeanSelectable selection system.

name: LeanPickable.cs
summary: Marker component making a GameObject pickable by LeanPick, exposing finger, screen-position, and world-position events when it is picked.

name: LeanPinchCamera.cs
summary: Zooms a camera from the pinch gesture, handling both orthographic size and perspective field-of-view, with damping, clamping, and optional zoom-toward-the-pinch-point behaviour.

name: LeanReplayFinger.cs
summary: Demonstration component that records the last finger stroke from LeanTouch snapshots and can replay it, moving a cursor Transform along the recorded path.

name: LeanSelectSelf.cs
summary: Emptied-out placeholder: the file contains only a UTF-8 BOM and a "// Remove" comment, with no code at all. Its former editor class survives as the misnamed LeanSelectSelf_Editor inside LeanPickable.cs.

name: LeanSelectableBlock.cs
summary: Reference implementation of a match-3 style grid block: it holds integer grid coordinates, swaps with the neighbouring block the selecting finger drags toward, and eases into its grid position.

name: LeanSelectableCenter.cs
summary: On demand, averages the world positions of every currently selected LeanSelectable and emits the centroid as a Vector3 event.

name: LeanSelectableDial.cs
summary: Turns the selected object into a dial or knob: dragging rotates it about a configured axis, with optional angle clamping and a list of angular triggers that fire enter/exit events.

name: LeanSelectableDragTorque.cs
summary: Adds physics torque to the attached Rigidbody based on how the selecting finger spins, so a selected object can be flicked into rotation.

name: LeanSelectableDrop.cs
summary: On finger release, raycasts under the selected object for an IDropHandler and hands the drop over to it, emitting the receiving GameObject and handler as events.

name: LeanSelectablePressureScale.cs
summary: Scales the selected object in proportion to the selecting finger pressure, for force-touch style feedback.

name: LeanSelectableSelected.cs
summary: Fires down/update/up events once a selectable has been held selected for a threshold number of seconds, with configurable reset timing and an optional require-a-finger gate.

name: package.json
summary: Unity Package Manager manifest for com.cwilkes.lean.touch-plus (v1.0.0, Unity 2019.4+), declaring runtime dependencies on the com.cwilkes.lean.common and com.cwilkes.lean.common-plus packages.

name: LeanSelectableTime.cs
summary: Defines a LeanSelectable companion component that accumulates how many seconds an object has been selected and broadcasts the running total through a UnityEvent, with a SendType switch controlling whether it fires only while selected, also on deselect, or every frame.

name: LeanSelectionBox.cs
summary: Implements drag-rectangle multi-selection: each finger spawns a RectTransform selection box prefab under a screen-filling canvas root, the box is resized as the finger drags, and on release every LeanSelectable inside the rectangle passing the layer and tag filters is handed to a LeanSelectByFinger component.

name: LeanShape.cs
summary: Defines a reusable 2D gesture shape as an ordered list of Vector2 points, optionally closed into a loop, with index wrapping/clamping accessors and optional LineRenderer visualisation. This is the reference data that LeanShapeDetector matches finger movement against.

name: LeanShapeDetector.cs
summary: The package's gesture-recognition core: records each finger's stroke as a decimated point list and, on release, matches it against a reference LeanShape using point-to-segment distance with configurable distance/error thresholds, partial-match minimums and forward/backward direction ranges, firing OnDetected on a match.

name: LeanSpawnWithFinger.cs
summary: Spawns a prefab at a finger's world position derived from a LeanScreenDepth conversion, optionally keeping it dragging under the finger, auto-selecting it via LeanSelect, and destroying it on release when dropped over blocked or missing screen-query targets.

name: LeanSwipeEdge.cs
summary: Detects swipes that originate at a screen edge, checking the swipe start against a scaled-pixel edge threshold and its direction against an angle tolerance for each enabled side, then firing a UnityEvent.

name: LeanTwistCamera.cs
summary: Rotates the attached GameObject (typically a camera) from a two-finger twist gesture, optionally pivoting around the finger centre in world space via LeanScreenDepth, with damped interpolation toward the target rotation.
